project.name: SEO Indexing & Webmaster Tools Setup
project.description: Set up Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and IndexNow for faster crawling and indexing of Return blog content

context.background: 941return.com has blog content that needs to be indexed by search engines. IndexNow code is implemented but needs key configuration. Webmaster tools need manual verification.

already_implemented: BlogPosting and BreadcrumbList schema on posts
needs_manual_setup: IndexNow key generation and env var

stories.title: Google Search Console Verification
stories.description: Verify site ownership in Google Search Console using DNS TXT record or HTML file method
acceptance_criteria: Site verified in Google Search Console
Domain property added (941return.com)
Sitemap submitted at /sitemap.xml
Initial crawl data visible in dashboard
stories.notes: Requires access to DNS settings or ability to upload HTML file to Railway deployment

stories.title: Bing Webmaster Tools Verification
stories.description: Verify site ownership in Bing Webmaster Tools for Microsoft search coverage
acceptance_criteria: Site verified in Bing Webmaster Tools
Can import settings from Google Search Console (faster)
Sitemap submitted
IndexNow API key obtained for story seo-3
stories.notes: Bing offers GSC import feature for quick setup. Generate IndexNow key here.

stories.title: IndexNow Key Configuration
stories.description: Configure IndexNow API key in Railway environment variables
acceptance_criteria: Generate IndexNow key from Bing Webmaster Tools
Add INDEXNOW_KEY environment variable in Railway
Verify key file accessible at /{key}.txt
Test URL submission works
stories.notes: Key should be 8+ alphanumeric characters. Code is already deployed, just needs env var.

stories.title: HowTo Schema for Technique Posts
stories.description: Add HowTo schema to meditation technique blog posts that have step-by-step instructions
acceptance_criteria: Add how_to_steps field to post frontmatter
Update blog/post.html template with conditional HowTo schema
Tag existing technique posts with how-to metadata
Test schema validation with Google Rich Results Test

stories.title: Search Console Performance Monitoring
stories.description: Set up weekly review of Search Console data to identify opportunities and issues
acceptance_criteria: Weekly task to review GSC performance report
Monitor for crawl errors and coverage issues
Track top queries and click-through rates
Identify low-CTR high-impression opportunities
stories.notes: This is an ongoing task, not a one-time setup

estimated_impact.indexing_speed: IndexNow can reduce indexing time from days to minutes
estimated_impact.visibility: GSC provides data on impressions, clicks, and ranking positions
estimated_impact.crawl_budget: Better sitemap structure helps search engines find all content
